verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or background-workflow capability in Vonage Video API. The automatic archive mode is a single session-level recording setting, and the event callbacks and webhooks are developer building blocks for constructing automations on one's own server. Neither is a product-provided facility for setting up automations that run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
